summary: Enhance your skills with our ICT Strategy, Governance, and Project Management Course. Gain essential knowledge to lead successful projects effectively.
lede: ICT strategy and governance training connects technology choices with organizational priorities and accountable delivery. It is for professionals who shape ICT direction, oversee investments, or coordinate projects across business and technical teams, helping them turn competing initiatives into a prioritized, controlled portfolio. Participants practice setting decision rights, evaluating business cases and dependencies, planning project scope and risks, and reporting progress and benefits through roadmaps and dashboards.
audienceIntro: ICT strategy governance training suits professionals who influence technology direction, control ICT investments, or coordinate projects across business and technical teams. It is appropriate for foundation to intermediate learners who need a common language and usable artefacts for ICT decision-making.
modules: ICT Risk, Change and Quality Control
prerequisites: You need a working understanding of how your organization uses ICT services, technology projects, or digital systems. No programming is required. Bring a laptop if you want to adapt the provided templates during exercises, although all core activities can use instructor-provided materials.
